dict.string: JR-Bar uses Automation to open a reviewed resume command in Terminal or iTerm2 when you choose Open. If you allow full Music controls, it reads and controls Music while its Dock card is open. Double-clicking a day in the Dock calendar shows that date in Calendar. Nothing is stored or sent.
JR-Bar reads the playing app's audio levels only while the notch's Audio visualizer setting is on, to draw its six-band animation. Audio is never recorded or stored.
JR-Bar announces a device connecting in the notch — "AirPods connected". Nothing is paired or sent.
JR-Bar shows the next event on the shelf and the Dock's Calendar tile, and only after you ask it to. Nothing leaves the Mac.
JR-Bar's Mirror row shows the Mac's own camera in the notch card — and only while the row is on. Nothing is recorded or sent.
JR-Bar uses Focus Status only when you choose Allow Focus Status, so Do Not Disturb can follow whether a macOS Focus is active.
JR-Bar's Wi-Fi rules need the network's name, which macOS shares only with Location on. Your location is never read or sent.

JR-Bar lists your next reminders on the shelf and in the Dock only after you allow access. Checking one off writes back to Reminders; nothing else is sent anywhere.
